name: HOG异常检测
description: 分析 梯度 orientation 分布s using Histogram of Oriented Gradients. AI images exhibit more uniform 梯度 orientations than natural scenes.
algorithm: Histogram of Oriented Gradients (HOG) + Entropy Analysis
mechanism: Computes 梯度 magnitudes and orientations, bins them into 9 bins. Higher 熵 indicates more uniform 分布 typical of AI.
parameters: Bins: 9, Orientation: unsigned [0,PI], Metric: normalized 熵
useCase: Detecting uniform 梯度 orientations in AI生成的 content

references.title: Dalal, N. & Triggs, B. (2005). Histograms of Oriented Gradients for Human Detection. CVPR.
Felzenszwalb, P.F. et al. (2010). Object Detection with Part-Based Models. IEEE TPAMI.
Lyu, S. & Farid, H. (2005). How Realistic is Photorealistic? IEEE TSP.

strengths:
• Captures local shape and 梯度 structure effectively
• Well-proven in computer vision since 2005
• 检测 structural 不一致 in AI生成的 content
• Multi-scale orientation 分析
• Robust to 光照 changes due to 梯度 normalization
limitations:
• 计算密集 for dense extraction
• Cell and block size parameters affect 灵敏度
• Textured regions may produce noisy descriptors
• Limited effectiveness on smooth, 特征less regions
• AI models increasingly generate realistic 梯度 structures
